name: organization
description: An organization (obo:OBI_0000245) is placed with obo:RO_0001025 (located in) against a city and country, and identified by a ROR identifier value node plus an acronym annotation. Identification and location are modelled as separate reusable individuals, not as literals on the organization.
competency_questions: Which organisations participate in NFDI-MatWerk?; What is an organisation's ROR identifier, and in which city is it located?; Which organisation is the parent of a given institute?; Which researchers, instruments and facilities belong to a given organisation?
